title: Visit the gin distillery on Maó harbour
description: Menorca's gin is an inheritance of the British century and is still distilled right on the quay, in copper stills more than 250 years old, over a local wood fire, from wine alcohol, juniper and well water from Maó. The guided visit ends in a tasting: gins, artisan liqueurs and pomada — gin with lemonade — which here is not a cocktail off a menu but the drink of the fiestas.
